name: memory
description: Saves, finds, and tidies what a project should remember: lasting facts, the current focus, and the glossary, in the built-in .memory/ folder, local Hindsight, or Notion.

interface.shortDescription: Save, find, and tidy what the project should remember.
interface.longDescription: Three skills for project memory. memory-save saves, corrects, or forgets one lasting fact and sends anything that belongs elsewhere to its home. memory-find looks up what the project already knows and cites each source. memory-tidy merges duplicates, retires stale facts, trims the current focus, and backs memory up. The project chooses one backend at setup: the built-in .memory/ folder, a local Hindsight server, or Notion.
defaultPrompt: What did we decide about this?
